subject: Payment reminder — Invoice {invoice_number} ({amount_fmt})
body:
Dear {contact_name},

This is a friendly reminder that invoice {invoice_number} for {amount_fmt} {days_text}.

If payment has already been made, please disregard this message. Otherwise, we would appreciate it if you could arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions about this invoice.

Best regards,
{sender_name}
{sender_company}
